Sponsored Products - Amazon Ads



Sponsored Products
Sponsored Products are cost-per-click (CPC) ads that promote individual
product listings on Amazon. You pay only when shoppers click your ad.
Ads appear in shopping results and on product detail pages. Sponsored
Products ads are created from your existing product listings, so no custom
ad copy or images are required.
Who can use it
Available to professional sellers, vendors, book vendors, and authors.
Brand Registry enrollment is not required for Sponsored Products.
Targeting
Choose automatic targeting, where Amazon matches your ads to shopping
queries and products, or manual targeting, where you select keywords or
products yourself. Campaigns set a daily budget, and you control the
maximum cost-per-click bid.
